title: Manager - Growth Experimentation & Marketing Technology
description:
**About Emeritus** 




 Emeritus is committed to teaching the skills of the future by making high\-quality education accessible and affordable to individuals, companies, and governments around the world. It does this by collaborating with more than 80 top\-tier universities across the United States, Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, India and China.
 



 Emeritus’ short courses, degree programs, professional certificates, and senior executive programs help individuals learn new skills and transform their lives, companies and organizations. Its unique model of state\-of\-the\-art technology, curriculum innovation, and hands\-on instruction from senior faculty, mentors and coaches has educated more than 300,000 individuals across 80\+ countries.
 



 Founded in 2015, Emeritus, part of Eruditus Group, has more than 1,800 employees globally and offices in Mumbai, New Delhi, Shanghai, Singapore, Palo Alto, Mexico City, New York, Boston, London, and Dubai. The company is backed by prominent investors including Accel, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Leeds Illuminate, Prosus Ventures, Sequoia Capital India, and Bertelsmann.
 



  





**Role Summary:** 




 The Marketing Innovation group owns every new initiative marketing undertakes across the global portfolio \- new channels, campaign structures, measurement signals and AI workflows. This role proves whether an initiative delivers incremental value, then builds the tooling to run it at scale.
 



 Deep, hands\-on expertise across Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn is a primary, non\-negotiable requirement, since most experiments run inside these platforms.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





**Paid media strategy and channel innovation (25%)** 
 Act as the structural authority on Google, Meta and LinkedIn for the portfolio. Design and pilot new account architectures, bidding approaches, audience strategies and creative testing frameworks before rollout. Evaluate new platform products and betas. Lead root\-cause analysis, decomposing cost per paid application into CPL, lead\-to\-application and application\-to\-paid rates. Maintain platform playbooks and QA standards.
 



  





**Experimentation and incrementality (30%)** 
 Own the experiment backlog: intake, prioritisation, sequencing and the scale\-or\-stop decision. Design tests using platform\-native tools, geo holdouts and matched\-market designs. Pre\-register hypotheses, size for minimum detectable effect, and read against pre\-set thresholds. Maintain incrementality factors by channel and geography. Control for audience overlap, budget cannibalisation and learning\-phase resets. Run an alpha–beta–production scaling framework and maintain the experiment ledger.
 



  





**AI tooling and automation (30%)** 
 Build tooling that removes manual work: diagnostic agents, creative pipelines, spend and delivery anomaly detection, automated campaign QA and alerting. Automate directly against the platform APIs. Integrate LLM APIs and agent frameworks with ad platform and CRM data, with evaluation harnesses to verify accuracy.
 



  





**Martech and measurement (15%)** 
 Own signal architecture: server\-side tracking and GTM, Meta CAPI, Google enhanced conversions and offline imports, LinkedIn CAPI, consent. Feed application, paid application and revenue signals back into bidding, and improve match quality and conversion coverage.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* 3 to 5 years in performance marketing, growth engineering or martech, with substantial hands\-on time in Google, Meta and LinkedIn.
* **Personal management of at least USD 3–5M annual media spend across two or more of these platforms.** 
 Agency\-overseen budgets without direct account ownership do not qualify.
* Platform depth, tested in interview: Meta (Advantage\+ vs manual, CBO, bid strategies, learning phase, EMQ, creative fatigue); Google (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, smart bidding, negative architecture, conversion action hierarchy, GCLID imports); LinkedIn (targeting limits, Matched Audiences, format selection, CPM management).
* Advanced SQL, Python for automation, and experience with at least one advertising API. Server\-side tracking and hands\-on LLM build experience.
* Statistical fluency: power, sample sizing, incrementality, and how marketing tests commonly fail.
* Preferred: a long lead\-to\-revenue funnel (edtech, fintech, insurance, high\-value D2C) and multi\-geography experience.



  





 Think you are the right fit? Apply right away!

description:
We are looking for a high\-calibre
 **Head – Quick Commerce** 
 to own and accelerate the company's growth across India's leading quick\-commerce platforms.
 



 This is a
 **business\-building and growth leadership role** 
 , not a traditional Key Account Management position. The ideal candidate will combine strong commercial acumen with deep hands\-on experience across
 **Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other emerging Q\-commerce platforms** 
 .
 



 With Quick Commerce becoming an increasingly important growth engine for FMCG and consumer brands, the role will be responsible for building the channel into a significant and profitable revenue contributor.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Own the
 **overall Quick Commerce P\&L, revenue and growth agenda** 
 .
* Develop and execute the Q\-commerce strategy across
 **Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket and other emerging platforms** 
 .
* Build strong relationships with platform
 **Category Managers, KAMs, commercial teams, media teams and supply teams** 
 .
* Own annual and quarterly
 **Joint Business Plans (JBPs)** 
 with key platforms.
* Drive growth through
 **assortment, pricing, promotions, visibility, distribution and new product launches** 
 .
* Lead commercial negotiations around
 **margins, trade spends, discounts, visibility and platform investments** 
 .
* Work closely with performance marketing to optimise
 **platform media, sponsored listings, ROAS and customer acquisition** 
 .
* Drive availability, fill rates, replenishment and inventory efficiency across dark\-store networks.
* Analyse platform\-level performance, consumer behaviour, SKU velocity and contribution margins to identify growth opportunities.
* Build differentiated strategies for each platform based on its customer base, category dynamics and economics.
* Partner closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Sales to ensure seamless execution.
* Build and lead a high\-performing
 **Q\-commerce/KAM team** 
 as the business scales.
* Establish strong reporting and performance dashboards covering
 **GMV, revenue, margins, availability, fill rate, ROAS, trade spends and contribution** 
 .



  





 Ideal Candidate
 


* **6–8 years of overall experience** 
 , with significant exposure to E\-commerce / Quick Commerce.
* At least
 **4–5 years of hands\-on experience managing Q\-commerce/e\-commerce businesses** 
 .
* Strong experience working directly with
 **Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and/or BigBasket** 
 .
* Proven track record of
 **scaling Q\-commerce revenue** 
 , preferably within FMCG, Food, Beverage, D2C or another high\-growth consumer category.
* Strong understanding of the complete Q\-commerce ecosystem —
 **KAM, category management, supply, availability, assortment, trade spends, platform media and performance marketing** 
 .
* Should be highly
 **sales and commercially oriented** 
 , with demonstrated ownership of revenue and profitability.
* Experience managing
 **platform P\&Ls/JBPs and commercial negotiations** 
 is essential.
* Strong analytical orientation with the ability to translate data into actionable growth initiatives.
* Prior experience in
 **FMCG / snacking / food / beverages** 
 would be strongly preferred.
* Candidates from high\-growth consumer brands, D2C companies or the Q\-commerce ecosystem are encouraged to apply.

title: Manager - Subscriber Communications
description:
Tata Play is India's leading DTH brand with over 15 million subscribers across the country. Staying true to its commitment of making tomorrow better than today, Tata Play’s growth over the years has been cemented by many innovations and enhancements. Tata Play offers over 50 services (Tata play curated entertainment channels – across genres and across languages), New broadcast channels enriching the entertainment experience for viewers. To extend this experience beyond the television screen, the Tata Play mobile app enables subscribers to manage their account and access live TV channels on the go, ensuring seamless entertainment anytime, anywhere.
 



  





 Who we are looking for:
 



  





 We are actively seeking a creative and analytical mind to drive subscriber communications to upsell broadcaster products, value\- added services available on Tata Play. Experience with AI\-based communication or analytical tools would be an added advantage. The ideal candidate must have hands on experience in building consumer\-facing brands, developing effective communications that leverage data and insights, managing agencies to direct and manage development of multiple campaigns \& flawless execution of campaigns across Tata Play owned media. This role is highly collaborative in nature \& the ideal candidate would be someone who enjoys working with people \& interacting with multiple stakeholders to solve creative \& business problems.
 



  





 KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES
 



 • A self\-motivated marketeer with a sharp analytical mindset, adept at interpreting consumer behavior, evaluating campaign performance, and monitoring industry shifts to proactively recommend communication strategies
 



 • Conceptualize clear brief that help guide and direct partner agencies to develop creatives that are relevant and clutter breaking
 



 • Highly proficient in conceptualizing and development of sharp and impactful creatives – principles of art, layout and relatable copy as per consumer medium/channel
 



 • Collaborate closely with marketing teams to ensure alignment of business objectives, understand promotional plans while sharing a sharp communication perspective
 



 • Influencing and managing expectations from senior stakeholders and cross functional teams \- Marketing, content, NPD, customer operations
 



 • Closely tracking KPIs on products and business allocated to you, to monitor efficiency \& effectiveness of communication \& recommend improvements
 



 • Data analysis to dig out learnings and developing hypothesis for testing
 



  





 Educational Qualification\- Full\-time PGDBA/MBA
 



  





 Experience \- 3\-4 years of related work experience.

title: Category Manager - Lifestyle (Indianwear)
description:
**Job Descrioption – Category Manager (Lifestyle – Indianwear)** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven and fashion\-forward
 **Category Manager – Indian Wear** 
 to lead category growth, brand partnerships, and assortment strategy across ethnic apparel, contemporary Indian fashion, and designer\-led brands. The role will drive GMV, profitability, customer experience, and category expansion by curating compelling assortments, building strategic brand partnerships, and delivering differentiated customer experiences aligned with business objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Category Strategy \& Business Ownership** 




 • Define and execute category growth plans aligned with the overall Indian Wear business strategy and annual operating plan.
 



 • Own category performance across GMV, gross margins, conversion rates, and customer satisfaction metrics.
 



 • Drive sales growth and profitability through effective assortment planning, pricing strategies, and commercial negotiations.
 



**Brand \& Partner Management** 




 • Build and strengthen relationships with leading ethnic wear, contemporary Indian fashion, and designer brands.
 



 • Identify and onboard new brands to expand category selection, improve market coverage, and drive customer acquisition.
 



 • Develop joint business plans with brand partners to drive sustainable growth and improve business performance.
 



**Assortment, Pricing \& Inventory Management** 




 • Curate a differentiated assortment across ethnic apparel, occasion wear, fusion wear, festive collections, and related categories.
 



 • Drive assortment expansion by balancing seasonal trends, new launches, core bestsellers, and emerging fashion opportunities.
 



 • Partner with brands and internal teams to optimize pricing, inventory availability, and inventory health.
 



**Marketing \& Growth Enablement** 




 • Collaborate with Marketing and Site Merchandising teams to drive category visibility, customer engagement, and conversion.
 



 • Plan and execute seasonal campaigns, festive events, designer launches, and key category initiatives in partnership with brands.
 



 • Leverage customer insights and market trends to identify growth opportunities and improve category performance.
 



**Customer Experience \& Quality Governance** 




 • Drive a seamless shopping experience by continuously improving product discovery, content quality, assortment relevance, and brand representation.
 



 • Monitor customer feedback, NPS, return rates, and operational metrics to identify and address improvement opportunities.
 



 • Partner with Customer Experience and Operations teams to resolve escalations and enhance customer satisfaction.
 



**Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Cataloguing, and Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of category plans.
 



 • Present category performance, key insights, and growth opportunities to senior stakeholders.
 



 • Drive innovation, process improvements, and best practices to enhance category efficiency and business outcomes.
 



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 




 • Strong experience in category management, buying, merchandising, or brand management within Indian wear, fashion, ethnic wear, or lifestyle categories.
 



 • Proven track record of driving category growth, GMV, and margin improvement.
 



 • Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and partner management skills.
 



 • Data\-driven decision\-making and strong analytical capabilities.
 



 • Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on delivering exceptional shopping experiences.
 



  





**Good\-to\-Have Skills** 




 • Experience working with ethnic wear, designer wear, occasion wear, or premium Indian fashion brands.
 



 • Exposure to e\-commerce, omnichannel retail, or marketplace business models.
 



 • Strong understanding of Indian fashion trends, festive consumption patterns, and customer behavior.
 



 • Experience managing large brand portfolios and strategic partnerships.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Fashion Management, Design, Marketing, or a related field.
 



 • MBA from a Tier 1/2 institute preferred.
 



 • 7\-10 years of experience in Category Management in ecommerce and/or retail roles within Indian Wear, Fashion, Lifestyle.
 



 • Demonstrated success in managing and scaling category performance through strong brand and business partnerships.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 • Opportunity to shape and scale one of India's fastest\-growing Indian Wear businesses.
 



 • High ownership role with direct impact on category growth, customer experience, and business performance.
 



 • Exposure to leading ethnic wear and designer fashion brands across India.
 



 • Collaborative and entrepreneurial environment with opportunities to drive innovation and business transformation.
 



 • Competitive compensation and strong career growth opportunities within Tata CLiQ.
